Key item features

  • 2 pack of Energizer 1.5V Silver Oxide Button Cell 377 Batteries for small, everyday electronics
  • Keep this long lasting battery pack stored in a cool, dry place until ready to use
  • Ideal button cell battery for medical monitoring devices, like heart rate monitors and glucose monitors, as well as calculators and key fobs
  • Energizer 377 button cell batteries last up to 5 years in storage for power whenever you need it
  • Silver oxide batteries with 1.5 volts make them suitable for various small electronic devices you use daily
  • Energizer is the #1 specialty brand of battery, ensuring dependable power when you need it
  • Replacement for a variety of button batteries, including 376/377, 377BP, D377, SB-AW, SR626SW and SR66

Reliable Battery That Lasts

Great battery. I bought a watch from an estate sale that wasn’t working and took a chance that it just needed a new battery. I ordered these, installed one, and it’s been running and keeping time perfectly ever since. What really stands out is how long it lasts. I’ve tried off-brand batteries before and they often stop working within a week, but this one has been going strong for quite some time now. Definitely a reliable choice if you want something that actually lasts.
